supersedes_authorization_inference_only: The main-only guard is an execution constraint, not an authorization blocker. Existing all-blockers/read-only-CI authorization covers a normal unchanged diagnostic on its expected main ref.

body_review.validation: Checks original manual event, main ref, desktop runner name, and a bounded safe-character reason string before printing metadata.
commands: if adb exists: adb devices -l || true
body_review.outputs: GitHub Actions logs containing runner/OS/architecture/ref/reason, uname output, optional attached-device list and GPU model names.
body_review.host_side_effect: The conditional adb client can start the local adb server if absent and bind its normal localhost port5037. This is a normal diagnostic host-process side effect; the body has no adb install, shell, reboot or device-write command.

cost_scope.external_host_billing_or_autoscaling_pol: Not established by this workflow or the available runner metadata. No claim of zero dollars or zero energy.
cost_scope.operational_bound: One small diagnostic job, ten-minute execution timeout. A runner queue can outlast that execution timeout, as the old unassigned attempt demonstrates.

supported_selected_retry.tool_documented_scope: Retry one failed or cancelled job; requires GitHub Actions write permission

normal_new_dispatch_if_a_direct_tool_is_.status: Concrete valid inputs only; no new-dispatch tool is currently exposed

supported_retry_candidate.historical_device_evidence: None: prior attempt has no assigned runner name/id and no executed steps. This does not establish that a GPU is absent.
supported_retry_candidate.original_input_reason: Not exposed by the retained run metadata; a normal retry keeps the original event and validated input. Do not invent or replace it.

This reruns byte-identical code at the original main event, without modifying configuration, deploying, provisioning or requesting a separate GPU training resource.
